ontario-kindergarten-2026.documentTitle: Ontario Kindergarten (2026) — Overall Expectations by Strand

standards.summaryText: communicate orally and non-verbally
standards.officialOutcomeText: communicate orally and non-verbally

standards.summaryText: apply early reading and writing skills
standards.officialOutcomeText: apply early reading and writing skills

standards.officialOutcomeText: understand and respond to a variety of texts by diverse creators from Canada and by diverse First Nations, Métis, and Inuit creators

standards.officialOutcomeText: create texts using foundational language knowledge and skills

standards.officialOutcomeText: apply the mathematical processes (i.e., problem solving; reasoning and proving; reflecting; connecting; communicating; representing; and selecting tools and strategies)

standards.summaryText: use numbers and operations
standards.officialOutcomeText: use numbers and operations

standards.summaryText: investigate repeating patterns
standards.officialOutcomeText: investigate repeating patterns

standards.officialOutcomeText: collect and display data to answer questions and communicate information, and explore probability in everyday contexts

standards.summaryText: describe two-dimensional shapes and three-dimensional objects, and the location and movement of people and objects
standards.officialOutcomeText: describe two-dimensional shapes and three-dimensional objects, and the location and movement of people and objects

standards.officialOutcomeText: use foundational coding concepts and skills

standards.officialOutcomeText: use an inquiry process to engage in scientific investigations and to design, build, and test models and structures

standards.officialOutcomeText: investigate natural and built environments

standards.officialOutcomeText: identify and use social skills in play and other contexts

standards.summaryText: demonstrate independence, self-regulation, and a willingness to take on responsibility
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate independence, self-regulation, and a willingness to take on responsibility

standards.summaryText: demonstrate an awareness of their own health and well-being
standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an awareness of their own health and well-being

standards.summaryText: participate actively and regularly in a variety of activities that require the application of movement concepts
standards.officialOutcomeText: participate actively and regularly in a variety of activities that require the application of movement concepts

standards.officialOutcomeText: develop movement skills and concepts as they use their growing bodies to move in a variety of ways and in a variety of contexts

standards.officialOutcomeText: demonstrate an understanding of the natural world and the need to care for and respect the environment

standards.officialOutcomeText: respond to a variety of forms of dance, drama, music, and visual arts from various cultures and communities, including using their language and mathematics knowledge and skills

standards.officialOutcomeText: explore and create a variety of art forms, including dance, drama, music, and visual arts
